name: review-chain
description: Adversarial review-chain workflow for Claude Code. Orchestrator drives request → design → implement → review with focused reviewers: a thin pre-pass (slop + scope), then deep review in sequential waves — citizen (quality, reuse, efficiency), then tracer (correctness, error handling, security) + test — with implementer fixes between waves a judge that adjudicates dispositions and scans the unreviewed fixes, a designer that triages every escalation, and a changelog author that finishes the ship squash.
